accommodations.intro: Choose between a central location by the station and generous space in peaceful green surroundings.

items.name: City Tiny House
items.headline: Central location. All to yourself.
items.summary: A fully renovated 42 m² tiny house in a quiet courtyard, just 200 metres from the railway station.
descriptions: The City Tiny House combines short distances with plenty of privacy. A private entrance, new bathroom and fitted kitchen make every stay easy, including longer visits.
The bright living area includes a smart TV, while outside a terrace overlooks the garden. Towels and bed linen are ready when you arrive.
amenities: Sofa bed in the living area
Laundry room in the adjacent building
items.imageAlt: Living area at the City Tiny House in Northeim

items.name: Ferienwohnung Langenholtensen
items.headline: More space. Plenty of peace.
items.summary: A 55 m² first-floor apartment with two bedrooms, a terrace and its own private entrance.
descriptions: Ferienwohnung Langenholtensen gives you room to arrive and unwind: two bedrooms, a living room, a well-equipped kitchen and a bathroom with both a shower and bath.
The terrace looks out onto greenery. Northeim town centre, the A7 motorway and the Leinebergland are only a few minutes away by car.
amenities: Double bed, single bed & sofa bed
items.imageAlt: Living and dining area at Ferienwohnung Langenholtensen

sections.title: 1. Data controllers
sections.body:
Sofija & Lenard Mill, Helene-Weber-Ring 17, 37154 Northeim, Germany
Email: info@ferienwohnungen-northeim.com, Phone: +49 172 8690737

sections.title: 2. Hosting
sections.body: This website is hosted by Netlify, Inc., 101 2nd Street, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA. When you access the website, the hosting provider processes technically necessary data (IP address, date and time, page requested and browser type) in server log files in order to deliver and secure the website. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in a secure and functional website). Netlify is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.title: 3. Smoobu booking system
sections.body: We use the booking system provided by Smoobu GmbH, Berlin, to display availability and accept direct bookings. When you use the booking area, your IP address and, if you make a booking, the information you enter (name, contact details, travel dates, number of guests and payment details) are transferred to Smoobu and processed there on our behalf. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (steps prior to entering into a contract and performance of a contract). A data processing agreement is in place with Smoobu.

sections.title: 4. Contact by email or phone
sections.body: If you contact us, we process the information you provide in order to respond to your enquiry (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). Our email is processed through Google Workspace (Google Ireland Ltd., Dublin). Statutory retention obligations, including those relating to invoices, remain unaffected.

sections.title: 5. Cookies and tracking
sections.body: We do not use analytics or advertising services ourselves. Within the embedded booking area, Smoobu may set technically necessary cookies required for searching and processing a booking.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and to object to processing based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. To exercise these rights, please contact the address above. You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the State Commissioner for Data Protection of Lower Saxony.
